Oliver — quick follow-up from FinOps: we generally require one of two flows for new ACH vendors:

Option A (preferred): ACH micro-deposits (2 small amounts) — faster mapping and immediate live pay once verified.
Option B: Prenotification (prenote) — used when the bank prefers not to receive micro-deposits; takes 3–5 business days.

Please confirm: account type (checking/savings) and whether the bank accepts micro-deposits. If yes, we’ll run the micro-deposit on Mon 2026-11-09 morning; you’ll see two entries under the account and need to confirm amounts by replying to this thread.

Also: please confirm if Skyline needs PO-level remittance (we can send both aggregated and PO-tagged payments). If PO-level remittance is required, tell us whether you prefer a CSV remittance file (our default) or an invoice-level webhook (more advanced, requires integration).

If you prefer, reply with the following in your body:
- account_type: checking
- accepts_micro_deposits: yes/no
- preferred_remit_format: csv/webhook
- earliest_date_for_test: YYYY-MM-DD

Thanks — I’ll wait for the confirmation to kick off the test.
